pamphlet_excerpts: Angle View Amount: The angle of view is the amount of a scene that a lens can takein.
Pointand-shoot Cameras Fixed: Some pointand-shoot cameras have a fixed focal length lens, giving youonly one angle of view.
Angle View Whathuman: This angle of view is much like whathuman eyes see in normal vision, roughly equivalent to a 50mmlens.
Cameras Zoom Lenses: Other cameras have zoom lenses, which give a varied focallength and varied angle of view.
step_by_step_procedure: Generally Wide-angle Lens: Generally, a wide-angle lens will give a larger angle ofview, while a telephoto lens compresses the subject and gives a smaller angle of view.
Wide-angle Lens Choicewhen: A wide-angle lens is a good choicewhen you are close to your subject.
Telephoto Lens Bestfor: A telephoto lens is bestfor subjects when you can’t get up close.
Earlier Discussed Importance: Earlier we discussed the importance of f-stops in controllingyour depth of field and what is in focus.

pamphlet_excerpts: ISO Simply Acronym: ISO is simply an acronym for the International Standards Organization.
Organization Sets Standard: This organization sets the standard by which camera sensors and their sensitivity to light are measured.
Bychanging ISO Setting: Bychanging the ISO setting, you control the relative sensitivityof the electronics in your camera to light.
Doublingof Number Camera: With every doublingof the number, the camera’s digital sensor becomes twice as sensitive to the light available for the picture.
step_by_step_procedure: Setting Twice Sensitivity: So a setting of 400 has twice the sensitivity of 200, and a setting of 800 istwice as sensitive as 400, etc.
Settings Shutter Speed: All three settings, shutter speed, aperture, and ISO, worktogether to achieve proper exposure.
Suppose Camera Setto: Suppose your camera is setto 1/125th of a second, f/8, and ISO 400.
But Want Photograph: But you want to photograph action and you know you will need a higher shutter speed, so you decide to use 1/500.

Success Require Magical: Success will require a magical combination of pressure on the spindle and the speedat which it spins.
Becomes Exhausted Several: The Scout becomes exhausted several timeswithout throwing a spark but, finally, achieves success.
step_by_step_procedure: Youare There Camera: And youare there with your camera, capturing the joy in the Scout’s face.
Reaction Facial Expression: The reaction is the Scout’s facial expression when he or she creates fire.
Difficult Winner: If it has all three (very difficult), it’s a winner.
Illustrating Idea Different: Illustrating an idea is different from covering an activity as ithappens.

Several Careers Listed: Several careers are listed inthis chapter, and there are many others.
Fields Photographers Work: Many fields have photographers who work only in those particular areas, includingsports, scientific, technical, educational, or research work.
Common Types Professional: The most common types of professional photography arecommercial, portrait, photojournalism, and specialized worksuch as taking medical.
step_by_step_procedure: Careerskeep Indoors Location: Some careerskeep you indoors in one location, while others may take youaround the globe.
Sped Fastnews Communicated: This has sped up how fastnews can be communicated worldwide.
Minutes Picture Thewire: Before digital photography, it would take 30 to 45 minutes to get a picture on thewire.
Photographer Now: A photographer can now photographan event like a rocket launch and have iton the internet within 10 seconds.
